task.title: Discover workflow runs by exact task attribution
task.objective: Complete issues https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/719 and https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/720 with a deterministic historical query over immutable task provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Return only runs attributed to one exact task in ascending exact run-ID order.
Include every lifecycle status after task termination and store reopen.
Return an empty result for no matches without requiring the task to exist.
Fail the complete query on any malformed workflow-run candidate history.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused workflow-run target failed to compile because WorkflowRunStore::list_for_task did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added exact filtering, ordering, lifecycle, task termination, reopen, empty-match, and malformed unrelated-history tests.

attempts.summary: Implemented the historical task query over authoritative replay.
attempts.diagnostic: Filtering the complete validated list by exact TaskId reused deterministic projection and avoided a secondary index or duplicate replay path.
attempts.patch: Added list_for_task and documented its historical, registry-free, non-authorizing semantics in ADR-0017 and the milestone list.

attempts.diagnostic: Independent review identified that unrelated malformed candidate history needed explicit regression coverage.
attempts.patch: Added the missing malformed-history case, retained all-or-nothing replay, and reran the focused and complete pinned gates.

outcome.summary: Callers can deterministically recover every workflow run historically attributed to one exact task without current task validation or a secondary index.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test workflow_run_store

lessons: A historical attribution query should not reinterpret current task existence or status as authorization.
Filtering an authoritative deterministic projection is safer than maintaining a second index before scale requires one.
Fail-closed discovery means malformed unrelated candidates invalidate the whole result rather than producing a plausible partial list.
Exact identity and existing order make the query deterministic without pagination or scheduling semantics.
